title: Molecular Mechanisms Underlying the Effects of Bimin Kang Mixture on Allergic Rhinitis: Network Pharmacology and RNA Sequencing Analysis.
authors: Qi, Li-Jie; Wang, Ren-Zhong; Gao, Shang; Chen, Xiang-Jing; Zhang, Xin; Zhang, Yi-Peng
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学、RNA-seq和分子对接研究中药复方治疗过敏性鼻炎的机制，虽涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Allergic rhinitis (AR) is a highly prevalent chronic inflammatory disease of the respiratory tract. Previous studies have demonstrated that Bimin Kang Mixture (BMK) is effective in alleviating AR symptoms and reducing the secretion of inflammatory factors and mucin; however, the precise mechanisms underlying these effects remain unclear. METHODS: We built target networks for each medication component using a network pharmacology technique and used RNA-seq transcriptome analysis to screen differentially expressed genes (DEGs) for AR patients and control groups. The overlapping targets in the two groups were assessed using PPI networks, GO, and KEGG enrichment analyses. The binding ability of essential components to dock with hub target genes was investigated using molecular docking. Finally, we demonstrate how BMK can treat AR by regulating the NF-kappaB signaling pathway through animal experiments. RESULTS: Effective targets from network pharmacology were combined with DEGs from RNA-seq, with 20 intersections as key target genes. The construction of the PPI network finally identified 5 hub target genes, and all hub target genes were in the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Molecular docking suggests that citric acid, deoxyandrographolide, quercetin, luteolin, and kaempferol are structurally stable and can spontaneously attach to IL-1beta, CXCL2, CXCL8, CCL20, and PTGS2 receptors. Animal experiments have shown that BMK inhibits NF-kappaB transcription factor activation, reduces the expression of proinflammatory cytokines and chemokines IL-1beta, CXCL2, IL-8, and COX-2, and exerts anti-inflammatory and anti-allergic effects. CONCLUSION: BMK by regulating the NF-kappaB signaling pathway improves inflammatory cell infiltration, regulates mucosal immune balance, and reduces airway hypersensitivity. These findings provide theoretical support for the clinical efficacy of BMK for AR treatment.
abstract_zh: 背景：过敏性鼻炎（AR）是一种高度流行的呼吸道慢性炎症性疾病。既往研究表明，鼻敏康合剂（BMK）能有效缓解AR症状，并减少炎症因子和黏蛋白的分泌；然而，其确切机制尚不明确。方法：我们采用网络药理学技术构建每种药物成分的靶点网络，并利用RNA-seq转录组分析筛选AR患者与对照组之间的差异表达基因（DEGs）。通过PPI网络、GO和KEGG富集分析评估两组中的重叠靶点。利用分子对接研究关键成分与核心靶基因的结合能力。最后，通过动物实验证明BMK通过调节NF-kappaB信号通路治疗AR。结果：将网络药理学获得的有效靶点与RNA-seq的DEGs相结合，得到20个交集作为关键靶基因。PPI网络的构建最终识别出5个核心靶基因，且所有核心靶基因均位于NF-kappaB信号通路中。分子对接提示，柠檬酸、去氧穿心莲内酯、槲皮素、木犀草素和山奈酚结构稳定，能自发结合至IL-1beta、CXCL2、CXCL8、CCL20和PTGS2受体。动物实验表明，BMK抑制NF-kappaB转录因子激活，降低促炎细胞因子和趋化因子IL-1beta、CXCL2、IL-8和COX-2的表达，发挥抗炎和抗过敏作用。结论：BMK通过调节NF-kappaB信号通路改善炎症细胞浸润，调节黏膜免疫平衡，并降低气道高反应性。这些发现为BMK治疗AR的临床疗效提供了理论支持。
